method: Every package entry in package-lock.json; the licence is read from the installed package.json when it is present, else from the lock file. "production" = not marked dev or devOptional by npm.
note: An SPDX OR expression counts as permissive when at least one alternative is permissive; an AND expression only when all are. Anything else is listed under nonPermissive for a person to review. This is a tool-assisted listing, not legal advice.
